title: Align shared cleanup evidence retention with open-task retention and Codex execution
outcome: The shared cleanup rule unambiguously retains evidence needed by every open task and routes directory removal through Codex.
acceptance: The shared .logs/.evidence wording agrees with the existing retain-until-every-served-task-closes rule and distinguishes that need from an explicitly recorded extension, without treating still-needed open-task evidence as removable.

Accountability of the last closer or sweep is distinct from Codex directory-removal execution, and exact shared wording follows existing concurrence/notification/audit and review/gate rules without new Markdown phrase tests.
